title: Independent reading workflow
subtitle: Make an evidence-based first reading before consulting translations.
overview: An independent first reading is orderly: divide the text, mark finite verbs, attach dependent material, identify key phrases, then use a lexicon selectively.
The aim is a transparent working translation with notes—not pretending that one first pass settles every grammatical or theological question.

sections.title: Five reading passes
rows: Mark clauses, speech, and paragraph transitions.
Parse finite verbs and recover subjects.
Look up only high-impact lexical forms.
Write literal then readable English, retaining uncertainties.

items.grc: καὶ ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει.
items.en: Dependent description: the one remaining in love remains in God.
